_comment: What the onboarding wizard's feed check matches, kept out of the code so a new feed type is a data edit; each refusal it makes is worded in the UI catalogs as feed_check.<code>. Structure stays in code: the order of the fetches, the <link> attributes read, how a name is made unique. Types match case-insensitively, against the part before any ';'.
_comment_types: feed_link_types: the <link rel="alternate"> types a home page names its feed with, RSS and Atom only, which are what both parsers read. html_types: the Content-Types of a page, as opposed to a feed, which decides whether a non-feed answer is refused as a page without a feed link or as not a feed at all.
